{{Quote|What are our losses?''"<br />"''Colonel Gidders's shuttle. Six E-wings on the ground and two in space.|Stavin Thaal and Unidentified Pop-Dog captain|<ref name="MK" />}}
A military '''shuttle''' was the personal [[Starship/Legends|starship]] of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gidders]], a member of the elite [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Galactic Alliance Army|Army]] unit the [[Pop-Dogs]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> the shuttle was at [[Chakham Army Base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kuratooine]] when a pair of [[X-wing starfighter|X-wing]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] piloted by members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a Galactic Alliance [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, strafed the launching pad of the base and destroyed six [[E-wing starfighter|E-wings]] and Gidder's shuttle during their [[Mission to Kuratooine|mission]] to prove the corrupt activities of General [[Stavin Thaal]], the leader of the Pop-Dogs.<ref name="MK" />
